notes.title: Machizzle: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
patch 1.0.2 is now available!

[h2][b]Patch 1.0.2:[/b][/h2]
- Fixed Music volume to reflect settings
- Fixed some achievements not registering properly
- Tutorial texts for original Vive controller are now bigger, which shoudl result in improved readability on original vive headset (rest of headsets were readable fine as they were). 
- Added play button for community levels (Library). It's was not needed, as once you select level, all you needed to do was toggle menu and play. But also was not really explained.
- Update app Icon

notes.title: Machizzle: Release Day Trailer
notes.notes:
The day is finally upon us, Machizzle will be launching on [b]January 7th, 2021[/b] on Steam!  Get ready to bend the laws of physics to solve mind breaking puzzles. 

The game will be launching with all of these exciting features: 

[list]
[*] [b]80-level campaign: [/b]Follow the story of Rock and his loyal companion, Stone by solving a series of unique VR puzzles.
[*] [b]10-15 hours average playtime:[/b] Take a dip into captivating gameplay that will test your puzzle-solving prowess!
[*] [b]18 puzzle pieces:[/b] Throughout the campaign, the levels will introduce distinct puzzle pieces that can help you conquer each level.
[*] [b]Detailed level and puzzle creator: [/b]Spend time creating the most intricate VR puzzles and levels using the base materials the game already has. Players have complete access to power-ups, different blocks, and the freedom to challenge themselves and other players.
[*] [b]Players can share their creations online:[/b] Players can share and challenge each other through the puzzles they created.
[/list]

Wishlist the game now on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301770/Machizzle/]Steam store page[/url] to be one of the first people notified of the full release on January 7th!
